product.olivetti-pcs52-e.summary: The PCS counterpart to the M4-82 Pentium platform.
product.olivetti-pcs52-e.history: Olivetti documented the PCS 52 E and M4-82 as two products on the same platform.
product.olivetti-pcs52-e.architecture: The board determines how storage connects. The BA2066 supports AT IDE and the BA2121 adds an RZ1000 PCI IDE controller.
product.olivetti-pcs52-e.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-pcs52-e.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-pcs52-e.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 1
product.olivetti-pcs52-e.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists BA2066 · 1.00.08 AF1 / BA2121 · 1.00.06 AF2.
